name: Code Diagram — Class Entities
description: C4 Code Diagram (Level 4) describes the details of entity classes in the domain model. Equivalent to UML Class Diagram but in the context of the C4 model.
purpose: Describe entity classes in detail with attributes, methods and relationships at the code level.
bestFor: Detailing entities in the domain model
Connecting C4 architecture design and actual code
useCases: Identify attributes and methods for each entity
requirements: REQ-001: Order has OrderDate, Status, TotalAmount
REQ-002: OrderItem has Product, Quantity, UnitPrice
REQ-003: Payment has Amount, PaymentMethod, Status
REQ-005: Each Order can have multiple Payments (partial payments)
